sections.text:
Placeholder lyrics for demonstration purposes.
Dharmesh gahi gun-kathan min-ke,
Naman aasin daona ra'i.
Asin puji nan-ke nam.

E Prabhu Yeshu daya nan-ke,
Ningan aara ra'inam purna jíwe te.

Dharmeshan sabba ge nam jiyara ban-a,
Sahia bar-ke aasin dandi paari-ke.
Nindki katha bidi khando lekh’a.

Bara he Prabhu Yeshu naman taran da-a,
Jiya khakha dandi men-ke.
Endr'im beddan e Prabhu daya nan-ke.

Ujgo dharre te chal-ke em-hai jiyara,
Sukh aara shanti em-pan ta-a.
